responsibility: Declares the shared high-level loop-transformation API used across tree SSA loop passes. It exposes helpers for IV creation, loop-closed SSA rewriting and verification, exit splitting, standard increment placement, loop body duplication, unrolling and transform callbacks, loop IV canonicalization, and the exported driver for loop invariant motion.
same_name_distinction: Declares the reusable loop-manipulation API used by other tree-SSA loop passes, including IV creation, loop-closed-SSA helpers, unrolling, and canonicalization entry points. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop-manip.cc, it is the interface layer, not the implementation of those transformations.
